page.text:
Set union and intersection satisfy algebraic symmetries that mirror the
algebra of real numbers, including commutativity, associativity, and
distributivity. However, Boolean algebras exhibit unique dualities—such
as the mutual distributivity of union over intersection and intersection
over union—that have no analogue in numerical arithmetic.
